name: State Farm Premier Cash Rewards Visa Signature Card

localized_names.en: State Farm Premier Cash Rewards Visa Signature Card

apr.notes: Variable purchase and balance transfer APR 17.74% to 30.74%; cash advance APR 30.74%. Balance transfer fee 5% ($5 min); cash advance fee 5% ($10 min).

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: Gas stations and EV charging stations, drugstores, grocery stores and dining

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem as a statement credit, deposit to a U.S. Bank savings or checking account, or a Rewards Card ($25 minimum). Cash back expires three years after it is earned.

signup_bonus.description: $150 bonus cash back after $500 in eligible net purchases within 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Auto deductible reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement of up to $200 of an auto policy deductible after a covered loss, with at least 8 net purchases in the prior month.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 if an eligible phone is stolen or damaged when the monthly bill is paid with the card.

notes: Issued by U.S. Bank National Association. Applying through a State Farm agent adds 2% cash back on insurance premiums in the first year (up to 5% total).
